== English Anthology family comparison ==
The Special Edition physical printing uses 'weapons segment' and removes the express instruction to pay normal movement cost. Decipher's 1998 Glossary identifies the weapon, power and damage segments and addresses the retreat of a side using this Interrupt. The default movement-cost rule still applies. Both cards retain the option to move any or all of the player's starships away and the instruction that any already hit cards must be lost.
